entries.text: 但人们必须离开圣地，走到外面的世界中。否则，圣地便成为监狱了。
entries.source_text: 但人们必须离开圣地，走到外面的世界中。否则，圣地便成为监狱了。

entries.text: Nobody wants peace. Everyone's out for numero uno, pal. Wake up!
entries.source_text: Nobody wants peace. Everyone's out for numero uno, pal. Wake up!

entries.text: 没有人需要和平。伙计,现在大家都只为自己卖命。醒醒吧！
entries.source_text: 没有人需要和平。伙计,现在大家都只为自己卖命。醒醒吧！

entries.text: Sounds good. Who do I see to sign up?
entries.source_text: Sounds good. Who do I see to sign up?

entries.text: 听起来不错。我要加入，该见谁呢？
entries.source_text: 听起来不错。我要加入，该见谁呢？

entries.text: Peace? Sanctuary? You're making me ill, zombie-boy!
entries.source_text: Peace? Sanctuary? You're making me ill, zombie-boy!

entries.text: 和平？圣地？少来装疯，你这傻瓜僵尸！
entries.source_text: 和平？圣地？少来装疯，你这傻瓜僵尸！

entries.text: I'm glad to hear you express an interest in peace. Talk with Father Morpheus and Brother Lasher. They can instruct you further.
entries.source_text: I'm glad to hear you express an interest in peace. Talk with Father Morpheus and Brother Lasher. They can instruct you further.

entries.text: 很高兴你表达出了对于和平的兴趣。去和墨菲斯神父还有拉舍尔兄弟谈谈，他们将给你进一步的启示。
entries.source_text: 很高兴你表达出了对于和平的兴趣。去和墨菲斯神父还有拉舍尔兄弟谈谈，他们将给你进一步的启示。

entries.text: I'm afraid I can't help you. Only Father Morpheus communes with the Master. You can find him in the tower.
entries.source_text: I'm afraid I can't help you. Only Father Morpheus communes with the Master. You can find him in the tower.

entries.text: 很抱歉我帮不了你。只有墨菲斯神父和主教有联系。你可以在塔中找到他。
entries.source_text: 很抱歉我帮不了你。只有墨菲斯神父和主教有联系。你可以在塔中找到他。

entries.text: Is there anything I should know before I meet him?
entries.source_text: Is there anything I should know before I meet him?

entries.text: 在我见他之前你还能告诉我什么？
entries.source_text: 在我见他之前你还能告诉我什么？

entries.text: Thanks. Be seeing you.
entries.source_text: Thanks. Be seeing you.

entries.text: 谢谢。再见。
entries.source_text: 谢谢。再见。

entries.text: Father Morpheus. That's a real peaceful sounding name. Who's his assistant, Brother Murder? Brother Death? Sister Kill maybe?
entries.source_text: Father Morpheus. That's a real peaceful sounding name. Who's his assistant, Brother Murder? Brother Death? Sister Kill maybe?

entries.text: 墨菲斯的意思是“梦神”啊。听起来的确是一个和平的名字。那么谁是他的助手呢？“谋杀”兄弟？“死亡”兄弟？也许是“杀戮”姐妹？
entries.source_text: 墨菲斯的意思是“梦神”啊。听起来的确是一个和平的名字。那么谁是他的助手呢？“谋杀”兄弟？“死亡”兄弟？也许是“杀戮”姐妹？

entries.text: I am more than willing to be reborn for my cause. Kill me if you must, but I will be redeemed and you will die.
entries.source_text: I am more than willing to be reborn for my cause. Kill me if you must, but I will be redeemed and you will die.

entries.text: 我非常愿意为我们的事业而重生。要是你想要杀我的话，就动手好了，但我会重生，我会得到救赎，而你将会死去。
entries.source_text: 我非常愿意为我们的事业而重生。要是你想要杀我的话，就动手好了，但我会重生，我会得到救赎，而你将会死去。

entries.text: Kid, one way or another, you're spilling your guts right now!
entries.source_text: Kid, one way or another, you're spilling your guts right now!

entries.text: 随你怎么说，小兔崽子，你马上就要死啦！
entries.source_text: 随你怎么说，小兔崽子，你马上就要死啦！

entries.text: I'd be happy if you just shut up. You zombies are giving me a headache.
entries.source_text: I'd be happy if you just shut up. You zombies are giving me a headache.

entries.text: 要是你闭上嘴我会很高兴的。你们僵尸总是让我头痛。
entries.source_text: 要是你闭上嘴我会很高兴的。你们僵尸总是让我头痛。

entries.text: You got guts, kid. I admire that. Maybe I won't kill you.
entries.source_text: You got guts, kid. I admire that. Maybe I won't kill you.

entries.text: 你很有勇气，僵尸，值得敬佩。也许我不该杀死你。
entries.source_text: 你很有勇气，僵尸，值得敬佩。也许我不该杀死你。

entries.text: I don't give a rat's ass about your soul, kid, but I'll be damned if I turn down the invitation. One martyr, coming up!
entries.source_text: I don't give a rat's ass about your soul, kid, but I'll be damned if I turn down the invitation. One martyr, coming up!

entries.text: 我大概感觉你的灵魂和他妈的变种老鼠的屁股一个样，但是你继续这样下去我就该收拾你了。醒醒把，神棍！
entries.source_text: 我大概感觉你的灵魂和他妈的变种老鼠的屁股一个样，但是你继续这样下去我就该收拾你了。醒醒把，神棍！

entries.text: Well... Uh.. Peace be with you.. I think... Farewell..
entries.source_text: Well... Uh.. Peace be with you.. I think... Farewell..

entries.text: 嗯……啊……愿和平与你同在。我想……再见。
entries.source_text: 嗯……啊……愿和平与你同在。我想……再见。

entries.text: Look around you? Do you not hear the messages? How can you doubt the Master's sincerity?
entries.source_text: Look around you? Do you not hear the messages? How can you doubt the Master's sincerity?

entries.text: 看看你的周围。你没有听到那些讯息吗？你怎敢怀疑主教的真实？
entries.source_text: 看看你的周围。你没有听到那些讯息吗？你怎敢怀疑主教的真实？

entries.text: Nobody wants peace. Everyone's out for numero uno, pal. Wake up!
entries.source_text: Nobody wants peace. Everyone's out for numero uno, pal. Wake up!

entries.text: 没有人需要和平。伙计,现在大家都只为自己卖命。醒醒吧！
entries.source_text: 没有人需要和平。伙计,现在大家都只为自己卖命。醒醒吧！

entries.text: It's easy to talk about peace, but what's the Master really doing?
entries.source_text: It's easy to talk about peace, but what's the Master really doing?

entries.text: 谈论和平自然是很简单的，但主教在做什么呢？
entries.source_text: 谈论和平自然是很简单的，但主教在做什么呢？

entries.text: Forgive me, brother. The world is such a terrible place, and I worry about losing our freedom..
entries.source_text: Forgive me, brother. The world is such a terrible place, and I worry about losing our freedom..

entries.text: 原谅我，兄弟。这世界是个可怕的地方，而我害怕丢掉我的自由。
entries.source_text: 原谅我，兄弟。这世界是个可怕的地方，而我害怕丢掉我的自由。

entries.text: It's easy to talk about peace, but I hear terrible rumors of mutant armies..
entries.source_text: It's easy to talk about peace, but I hear terrible rumors of mutant armies..

entries.text: 谈论和平自然是很简单的，但我听说了关于变种人军队的可怕谣言。
entries.source_text: 谈论和平自然是很简单的，但我听说了关于变种人军队的可怕谣言。

entries.text: Maybe you're right. Who do I see to sign up?
entries.source_text: Maybe you're right. Who do I see to sign up?

entries.text: 也许你是对的。我想加入，该去见谁呢？
entries.source_text: 也许你是对的。我想加入，该去见谁呢？

entries.text: Sincerity only comes out of the barrel of a gun!
entries.source_text: Sincerity only comes out of the barrel of a gun!

entries.text: 只有枪杆子里才有真诚！
entries.source_text: 只有枪杆子里才有真诚！

entries.text: He is Keeper of the Holy Flame, one who strives to wipe away all divisions, all hatreds. He wields both sword and plowshare, but would rather build than destroy. Hail the Master! Hail Unity!
entries.source_text: He is Keeper of the Holy Flame, one who strives to wipe away all divisions, all hatreds. He wields both sword and plowshare, but would rather build than destroy. Hail the Master! Hail Unity!

entries.text: 他是圣火的保护者，他毕生经历都用在了打破种族间的偏见，扫除所有仇恨的事业上。他同时掌控着剑和犁，但比起破坏，他更喜欢建设。向主教致敬！向大同世界致敬！
entries.source_text: 他是圣火的保护者，他毕生经历都用在了打破种族间的偏见，扫除所有仇恨的事业上。他同时掌控着剑和犁，但比起破坏，他更喜欢建设。向主教致敬！向大同世界致敬！

entries.text: I hear that our Crusade goes well. We are marching north, and as the Master promised, the forces of the Dark Age are no match for an army of the Enlightened. These are glorious times! Lift up your head, friend, and shout with praise!
entries.source_text: I hear that our Crusade goes well. We are marching north, and as the Master promised, the forces of the Dark Age are no match for an army of the Enlightened. These are glorious times! Lift up your head, friend, and shout with praise!

entries.text: 我听说我们的讨伐进行得很顺利。我们在向北行进，就和主教向我们许诺的一样，黑暗的力量与光明的力量根本无法相比。这是伟大的时代！抬起你的头，朋友，喊出你的赞美吧！
entries.source_text: 我听说我们的讨伐进行得很顺利。我们在向北行进，就和主教向我们许诺的一样，黑暗的力量与光明的力量根本无法相比。这是伟大的时代！抬起你的头，朋友，喊出你的赞美吧！

entries.text: And what happens to those we defeat? Can we dispel a Dark Age with blood? With tyranny?
entries.source_text: And what happens to those we defeat? Can we dispel a Dark Age with blood? With tyranny?

entries.text: 被我们打败的那些人会怎样呢？我们用血和暴行就能驱走黑暗吗？
entries.source_text: 被我们打败的那些人会怎样呢？我们用血和暴行就能驱走黑暗吗？

entries.text: Man, I wanna just start dancing!
entries.source_text: Man, I wanna just start dancing!

entries.text: 我现在好想跳舞呀！
entries.source_text: 我现在好想跳舞呀！

entries.text: Well I've heard all I need to know.
entries.source_text: Well I've heard all I need to know.

entries.text: 很好，我已经听到了所有我需要知道的事情。
entries.source_text: 很好，我已经听到了所有我需要知道的事情。

entries.text: No thanks. I've got a sore throat. I'd rather celebrate in my own way - by killing you!
entries.source_text: No thanks. I've got a sore throat. I'd rather celebrate in my own way - by killing you!

entries.text: 不，谢了。我嗓子有点痛。我最好以我自己的方式来庆祝……杀了你！
entries.source_text: 不，谢了。我嗓子有点痛。我最好以我自己的方式来庆祝……杀了你！

entries.text: I did not mean to insult you, nor to interfere in your duties. Please accept my apologies. May the Master bless you for your service.
entries.source_text: I did not mean to insult you, nor to interfere in your duties. Please accept my apologies. May the Master bless you for your service.

entries.text: 我并不是想要侮辱你，也并不想打扰你的工作。请接受我的道歉。愿主教因你的效忠而护佑你。
entries.source_text: 我并不是想要侮辱你，也并不想打扰你的工作。请接受我的道歉。愿主教因你的效忠而护佑你。

entries.text: My apologies. Praise the Master, and have a nice day.
entries.source_text: My apologies. Praise the Master, and have a nice day.

entries.text: 我很抱歉。赞美主教，愿你一天愉快。
entries.source_text: 我很抱歉。赞美主教，愿你一天愉快。

entries.text: Yours is a sad soul, my friend. I can only guess what horrors you've seen that makes you close your mind. Open it now, and find peace. Watch the screens, listen to Father Morpheus, and praise the Master.
entries.source_text: Yours is a sad soul, my friend. I can only guess what horrors you've seen that makes you close your mind. Open it now, and find peace. Watch the screens, listen to Father Morpheus, and praise the Master.

entries.text: 你的灵魂非常悲伤，我的朋友。是什么样的恐怖令你的心灵关闭，我现在只能猜测。打开你的心灵吧，获得安宁。看看那些屏幕，听听墨菲斯神父的布道，赞美主教吧。
entries.source_text: 你的灵魂非常悲伤，我的朋友。是什么样的恐怖令你的心灵关闭，我现在只能猜测。打开你的心灵吧，获得安宁。看看那些屏幕，听听墨菲斯神父的布道，赞美主教吧。

entries.text: I know nothing, my friend, nothing! You shall have to find someone else to answer your inquiry. But it is not wise to ask about the Nightkin.
entries.source_text: I know nothing, my friend, nothing! You shall have to find someone else to answer your inquiry. But it is not wise to ask about the Nightkin.

entries.text: 我什么都不知道，我的朋友，什么都不知道！你应该去找其他的人来问你的问题。但不应该去问夜行团。
entries.source_text: 我什么都不知道，我的朋友，什么都不知道！你应该去找其他的人来问你的问题。但不应该去问夜行团。

entries.text: Sure. No problem.
entries.source_text: Sure. No problem.

entries.text: 当然。没问题。
entries.source_text: 当然。没问题。

entries.text: Why's that?
entries.source_text: Why's that?

entries.text: 为什么？
entries.source_text: 为什么？

entries.text: I only have one question about them. Do they scream real loud when you kill them?
entries.source_text: I only have one question about them. Do they scream real loud when you kill them?

entries.text: 我只有一个问题要问他们。他们被杀死的时候惨叫声有多大？
entries.source_text: 我只有一个问题要问他们。他们被杀死的时候惨叫声有多大？

entries.text: You know nothing? You must be stupid?
entries.source_text: You know nothing? You must be stupid?

entries.text: 你什么都不知道？你是傻子吗？
entries.source_text: 你什么都不知道？你是傻子吗？

entries.text: Nightkin! Nightkin! Kill!
entries.source_text: Nightkin! Nightkin! Kill!

entries.text: 夜行团！夜行团！杀呀！
entries.source_text: 夜行团！夜行团！杀呀！

entries.text: This has been a wonderful talk, but I am falling behind in my praises. Farewell. Praise the Master! Praise the Holy Flame! Let us sing the sacred songs..
entries.source_text: This has been a wonderful talk, but I am falling behind in my praises. Farewell. Praise the Master! Praise the Holy Flame! Let us sing the sacred songs..

entries.text: 这次谈话非常有意义，但我的赞美已经落后于进度了。再见。赞美主教！赞美圣火！让我们来唱一些圣歌吧……
entries.source_text: 这次谈话非常有意义，但我的赞美已经落后于进度了。再见。赞美主教！赞美圣火！让我们来唱一些圣歌吧……

entries.text: If you do not like it here, you can leave. Praise the Master, and have a nice day.
entries.source_text: If you do not like it here, you can leave. Praise the Master, and have a nice day.

entries.text: 如果你不喜欢这里，你尽可以离开。赞美主教，并祝你日安。
entries.source_text: 如果你不喜欢这里，你尽可以离开。赞美主教，并祝你日安。

entries.text: I pity the Wastes, if that is a sample of the warped humor it breeds. I would not share it with the others.
entries.source_text: I pity the Wastes, if that is a sample of the warped humor it breeds. I would not share it with the others.

entries.text: 如果那是废土上产生的幽默感的话，我为废土感到遗憾。我不会把这种幽默感和别人分享的。
entries.source_text: 如果那是废土上产生的幽默感的话，我为废土感到遗憾。我不会把这种幽默感和别人分享的。

entries.text: Anyone in particular I should avoid?
entries.source_text: Anyone in particular I should avoid?

entries.text: 我应该特别避开哪些人？
entries.source_text: 我应该特别避开哪些人？

entries.text: This place must be no fun at all!
entries.source_text: This place must be no fun at all!

entries.text: 这个地方一定没有任何乐趣！
entries.source_text: 这个地方一定没有任何乐趣！

entries.text: Okay, I'll cut the jokes.
entries.source_text: Okay, I'll cut the jokes.

entries.text: 好吧，我不再说笑话了。
entries.source_text: 好吧，我不再说笑话了。

entries.text: Have you heard the one about the nuke jockey and the traveling salesman?
entries.source_text: Have you heard the one about the nuke jockey and the traveling salesman?

entries.text: 你听说过关于核操作员和旅行推销员的事情吗？
entries.source_text: 你听说过关于核操作员和旅行推销员的事情吗？

entries.text: Are you sure I can't show you what I do for laughs..
entries.source_text: Are you sure I can't show you what I do for laughs..

entries.text: 我不会拿你开玩笑的……
entries.source_text: 我不会拿你开玩笑的……

entries.text: Not that I can think of. Farewell, friend.
entries.source_text: Not that I can think of. Farewell, friend.

entries.text: 我不关心那个。再见，我的朋友。
entries.source_text: 我不关心那个。再见，我的朋友。

entries.text: I do not believe that I can help you, my friend. Farewell, and have a nice day. Praise the Master! Praise the Holy Flame..
entries.source_text: I do not believe that I can help you, my friend. Farewell, and have a nice day. Praise the Master! Praise the Holy Flame..

entries.text: 我不认为我能帮助你，我的朋友。再见，祝你日安。赞美主教！赞美圣火……
entries.source_text: 我不认为我能帮助你，我的朋友。再见，祝你日安。赞美主教！赞美圣火……

entries.text: I can't help you with that, I'm afraid. Well, I must meditate on the glories of the Master. Please excuse me. Hail the Master! Praise the Holy Flame!
entries.source_text: I can't help you with that, I'm afraid. Well, I must meditate on the glories of the Master. Please excuse me. Hail the Master! Praise the Holy Flame!

entries.text: 恐怕我不能帮助你。嗯，我现在必须冥想关于主教的光辉业绩了。请原谅。向主教致敬！赞美圣火！
entries.source_text: 恐怕我不能帮助你。嗯，我现在必须冥想关于主教的光辉业绩了。请原谅。向主教致敬！赞美圣火！

entries.text: Everyone here is filled with love! But it's hard for some people to express their love, and the Nightkin find it extremely hard to express it. But you shall discover this on your own. Praise the Master! Praise the Holy Flame!
entries.source_text: Everyone here is filled with love! But it's hard for some people to express their love, and the Nightkin find it extremely hard to express it. But you shall discover this on your own. Praise the Master! Praise the Holy Flame!

entries.text: 这里的每个人都充满了爱！但对于某些人来说，表达出爱是非常困难的，而夜行团表达爱是尤其困难的。但你应该自己去发现这些。赞美主教！赞美圣火！
entries.source_text: 这里的每个人都充满了爱！但对于某些人来说，表达出爱是非常困难的，而夜行团表达爱是尤其困难的。但你应该自己去发现这些。赞美主教！赞美圣火！

entries.text: We must submit to the Master and the Holy Flame. When we have proven ourselves, we shall become baptized and closer to God. When all have been baptized, we shall be as one, a Unity under the Master!
entries.source_text: We must submit to the Master and the Holy Flame. When we have proven ourselves, we shall become baptized and closer to God. When all have been baptized, we shall be as one, a Unity under the Master!

entries.text: 我们必须把自己的一切献给主教和圣火。当我们证明了我们自己之后，我们将得到洗礼，更加接近神。当所有人都接受洗礼之后，我们将成为了一个人，主教的联合军！

entries.text: Tell me more about this baptism.
entries.source_text: Tell me more about this baptism.

entries.text: 告诉我关于这个洗礼的事情。
entries.source_text: 告诉我关于这个洗礼的事情。

entries.text: What happens if someone doesn't want to be baptized?
entries.source_text: What happens if someone doesn't want to be baptized?

entries.text: 如果有人不想接受洗礼怎么办？
entries.source_text: 如果有人不想接受洗礼怎么办？

entries.text: Sounds interesting. Mind if I look around a little more?
entries.source_text: Sounds interesting. Mind if I look around a little more?

entries.text: 听起来很有趣。我想在周围看看，你介意吗？
entries.source_text: 听起来很有趣。我想在周围看看，你介意吗？

entries.text: I think you're all a bunch of zombies.
entries.source_text: I think you're all a bunch of zombies.

entries.text: 我认为你们不过是群没趣的僵尸。
entries.source_text: 我认为你们不过是群没趣的僵尸。

entries.text: There's only one Unity for mankind, and that's when we become wormfood.
entries.source_text: There's only one Unity for mankind, and that's when we become wormfood.

entries.text: We have a right to survive. The ancients tried to survive and keep their freedom, and look at what they did to us! We must not make the same mistakes. Unity is the only solution. It's the only way to save what humanity has become!

entries.text: We're forging a world that's better for everyone. That's all. I'm sorry if you don't understand yet. I pray that someone wiser than I can change your mind. Farewell, my friend. Praise the Master! Praise Peace and Unity!

entries.text: 我们在为所有的人创造一个更好的世界。那就是全部。我很遗憾你并没有理解。我祈祷会有更智慧的人能够改变你的主意。再见，我的朋友。赞美主教！赞美和平与“同一”！

entries.text: The world holds many surprises, my friend, some pleasant, some unpleasant. Farewell, my friend, and praise the Master!
